steps.output:
def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    n=len(g); m=len(g[0])
    # Find a one-cell solid separator. Compare patterned lines on its two sides.
    bg=max({v for row in g for v in row}, key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    sep_rows=[r for r in range(n) if len(set(g[r]))==1 and g[r][0]!=bg]
    sep_cols=[c for c in range(m) if len({g[r][c] for r in range(n)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg]
    # Select the separator that has non-background patterns on both sides.
    candidates=[]
    for r in sep_rows:
        above=[(rr,c) for rr in range(r) for c in range(m) if g[rr][c]!=bg]
        below=[(rr,c) for rr in range(r+1,n) for c in range(m) if g[rr][c]!=bg]
        if above and below: candidates.append(('h',r))
    for c in sep_cols:
        left=[(r,cc) for r in range(n) for cc in range(c) if g[r][cc]!=bg]
        right=[(r,cc) for r in range(n) for cc in range(c+1,m) if g[r][cc]!=bg]
        if left and right: candidates.append(('v',c))
    orient,s=candidates[0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if orient=='h':
        refrows=range(s) if s<n-s-1 else range(s+1,n)
        movrows=range(s+1,n) if s<n-s-1 else range(s)
        rr=list(refrows); mv=list(movrows)
        wall=g[s][0]
        ref=max(rr,key=lambda r:sum(v!=bg and v!=wall for v in g[r]))
        src=max(mv,key=lambda r:sum(v!=bg and v!=wall for v in g[r]))
        near=s+1 if s<n-s-1 else s-1
        far=n-1 if s<n-s-1 else 0
        for c in range(m):
            if g[src][c]!=bg and g[src][c]!=g[s][0]:
                out[src][c]=bg
                out[near if g[src][c]==g[ref][c] else far][c]=g[src][c]
    else:
        left=s<m-s-1
        ref=s-1 if left else s+1
        src=s+1 if left else s-1
        near=s+1 if left else s-1
        far=m-1 if left else 0
        wall=g[0][s]
        for r in range(n):
            if g[r][src]!=bg and g[r][src]!=wall:
                out[r][src]=bg
                out[r][near if g[r][src]==g[r][ref] else far]=g[r][src]
    return out
